forbidden.name: core-single-dependency
forbidden.comment: Core purity: runtime-core ships exactly one runtime dependency (semver). This single rule covers every host library (react, vite, sql.js, indexeddb, bun) at once.

forbidden.name: core-no-node-builtins
forbidden.comment: The core is environment-neutral; AbortController/EventTarget and friends are host globals, never node: imports.

forbidden.name: internal-not-importable-across-packages
forbidden.comment: packages/runtime-core/src/internal is unreachable outside runtime-core; the exports map enforces this at packaging time, this rule enforces it at source time.

forbidden.name: adapters-depend-on-core-only
forbidden.comment: Adapters depend on core; core never depends on an adapter, and adapters never import each other.

forbidden.name: examples-use-core-only
forbidden.comment: Example hosts share only the core and the public test kit, not application code.
